images.author: Tontan Travel
images.why: Documented wild banteng bull in Huai Kha Khaeng, Thailand, surrounded by green forest vegetation. Listed 2048-wide file; chestnut rather than black coat, photographed from an observation tower.

images.author: Christoph Moning
images.why: Dark-coated banteng with pale stockings standing in open grassland; original JPEG link. Photo-specific licence, wild status and dimensions could not be independently confirmed.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Male western giant eland with long spiral horns, dark neck and white body stripes in dry woodland. Conservation-project photograph; precise location and resolution unconfirmed. Licence is stated site-wide.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Giant elands in warm evening woodland light at Fathala, Senegal. Habitat-rich alternative, but a group in a managed conservation reserve rather than an isolated wild bull; resolution unconfirmed.

images.author: Oskar Jabłoński
images.why: Explicitly identified European bison in Białowieża, Poland, with striking frost and snow detail. Strong solitary subject; reclining rather than standing. URL requests 3000 pixels wide.

images.author: Oskar Jabłoński
images.why: Confirmed European bison in Białowieża meadow habitat. Standing animals and natural green colour; family group rather than a confirmed solitary bull, making the 9:10 crop less straightforward.

images.author: Lester Reetley
images.why: Standing common elands at Dikhololo Game Reserve, South Africa. Natural field setting and free licence; two animals rather than an isolated bull. URL requests 3000 pixels wide.

images.author: Dixon Newman
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies common eland in Lake Mburo National Park, Uganda. Standing animals in lush green habitat; useful full-body alternative, although sex is not confirmed.

images.author: Gio's Studio
images.why: Confirmed male eland looking toward the camera at Ol Pejeta Conservancy, Kenya. Good male-subject alternative, but resting with legs folded instead of standing.

images.author: Matthew Stephenson
images.why: Standing bull with broad palmate antlers, warm autumn grass and forest-edge surroundings. Strong poster candidate with golden-hour colour; URL requests 3000 pixels wide.

images.author: Matthew Stephenson
images.why: Large antlered bull walking through a naturally lit grassy clearing. More dynamic pose and substantial body visibility; preserve the antler tips when cropping to 9:10.

images.author: Camerauthor Photos
images.why: Documented bull moose in Northern Ontario, framed by autumn shrubs and tall grasses. Strong northern-habitat context and prominent antlers; vegetation partly obscures the legs.
